files.justification: GATE 3 naming test: verified by reading the file — cluster A 'job-processing engine' (WorkerConfig, JobContext, JobRequest, JobResult, OutcomeContext, _handle_outcome, JobSafeProcessor, JobResultProducer, JobProcessor, DaemonRunner, _undo_retry_attempt) drives the daemon tick loop and calls worker.queue (q.*) directly; cluster B 'CLI queue-inspection commands' (EnqueueCommand, ListCommand, StatusCommand, ShowCommand, RequeueErrorsCommand, RetryCommand, PurgeCommand) also call worker.queue (q.*) directly but never call into JobProcessor or DaemonRunner, and vice versa. Both depend on the shared worker.queue module but not on each other, and share no module-level mutable state.
